field_meaning.hi: हिंदुओं के विवाह और तलाक को नियंत्रित करने वाला कानून।

review_objections: Alibaba: The official name is 'Hindu Marriage Act, 1955'. 'Marriage Act, 1955' is ambiguous and could refer to the Special Marriage Act (1954) or others. However, the Hindi description specifies 'Hindus', so it refers to the HMA. The term itself is slightly informal/incorrect as a proper noun.
